title: Manipulator Kinematic and Dexterity Analysis Results
description: Output schema for multi-variant URDF robot arm analysis including validation, differential kinematics, and workspace metrics

best_max_reach.description: Variant ID with highest maximum reach distance

best_avg_manipulability.description: Variant ID with highest average Yoshikawa manipulability

best_dexterous_fraction.description: Variant ID with highest dexterous workspace fraction

kinematic_analysis.description: Kinematic analysis results keyed by query ID. null if variant is invalid.

workspace_analysis.description: Workspace analysis results. null if variant is invalid.

is_valid.description: True if check_urdf validates the URDF successfully

root_link.description: Name of the root link reported by check_urdf. null if validation failed.

num_links.description: Total number of <link> elements in the URDF file

num_joints.description: Total number of <joint> elements in the URDF file

position.description: End-effector (tool0) position [x, y, z] in base_link frame

rotation_matrix.description: 3x3 rotation matrix of tool0 in base_link frame, row-major nested list

jacobian.description: 6x6 geometric Jacobian. Rows 0-2: linear velocity (x,y,z). Rows 3-5: angular velocity. Columns follow joint_order.

manipulability.description: Yoshikawa manipulability index: w = sqrt(det(J * J^T)), equivalently the product of all singular values of J

singular_values.description: Singular values of J sorted in descending order

condition_number.description: Ratio of largest to smallest singular value (sigma_max / sigma_min). Capped at 1e12 if sigma_min < 1e-10.

singularity_class.description: Classification based on minimum singular value: 'singular' if sigma_min < 0.001, 'near_singular' if sigma_min < 0.01, otherwise 'well_conditioned'

static_torques.description: Joint torques required to resist the external wrench: tau = J^T * wrench. Order matches joint_order.

max_reach.description: Maximum Euclidean distance from base_link origin to tool0 origin, over all configurations within joint limits

dexterous_workspace_fraction.description: Fraction of Monte Carlo samples where manipulability exceeds the threshold

average_manipulability.description: Mean Yoshikawa manipulability across all Monte Carlo samples
